effect.name: FlareFX
effect.description: Simulates sunlight hitting a camera lens: a bright core, colored rings, and a scattering of small reflectors that travel through the frame center as the light source moves, based on the classic GIMP FlareFX algorithm
effect.author: frei0r

parameter.name: X
parameter.comment: Horizontal position of the light source

parameter.name: Y
parameter.comment: Vertical position of the light source

parameter.name: Brightness
parameter.comment: Overall opacity/intensity of the flare overlay

parameter.name: Spread
parameter.comment: How far the small reflectors travel through the frame center as the light moves off-center
